source_policy: Direct patch of frozen v7 files; does not apply the patch to v8. v8 remains a failed-surface-overlap artifact with its executed sources archived.

angle_definitions.prepared_axes: +Y up/+Z forward; positions metres; angles degrees
angle_definitions.guard_calibrated: Qg is source0 prepared Head world rotation; F_local=Qg^-1 Z, ear/right_local=Qg^-1 X, guard pitch/roll0; positive pitch up
angle_definitions.fixed_rest_axis: rest Head world rotation calibrates prepared+Z; equivalent to former raw+X rest anatomical forward; guard here is approximately+4.48deg, not0
angle_definitions.anatomical_roll: ear/right vector angle in the level-heading right and forward/world-up reference; retained by the sagittal swing
angle_definitions.ear_line_elevation: asin(world ear/right Y); this literal line elevation can change with pitch even when anatomical roll is retained

calibration_and_grounding.raw_R15: inherited unchanged original reviewed UNBAKED R15; original grip source/native2.117 per parent-v7 inputs

contact.coordinate_frame: prepared glTF +Y up/+Z forward; metres; includes the one formal root shift; normal dimensionless
contact.contact_and_binding_basis: v7 actual authored blade path; only neck subtree differs

invariants.world_matrix_scope: all nodes outside the complete NeckTwist01 descendant subtree
invariants.chest_policy: not corrected; Hip→Spine02 centreline and chest full world matrix remain v7, while Head→Hip lean can change

surface_scan.scope: one union scan: full 0–1.75 seconds at 60Hz, plus 240Hz keys in 0.45–0.72 seconds and the exact 0.72 boundary; all body primitives and unique vertex pools

APK_reimport.authority: Complete fine_overhead_raw.glb from v9, including all234 channels and the full v7-authored hip/body/arm/hand/blade trajectory plus the v9 neck correction; not a two-neck delta onto the current formal model.
APK_reimport.target_handling: Root retargets/imports using each target rig and calibration; do not reapply preview calibration or substitute old hand tracks
APK_reimport.inheritance: R_Upperarm/R_Forearm/R_Hand remain the v7 authored attack tracks unchanged; no claim that all ACTIVE wrist-local rotations are native
APK_reimport.SDK_device_build_Git_release: Root-owned, not performed by this source lane

limits: Before source0.50 the v7 head posture is deliberately retained so the original preparation blade arc can clear the head; the near-horizontal target is reached at0.65.
Anatomical yaw/roll are retained, including parent lateral head tilt; literal ear-line elevation can change with pitch.
C2 describes the envelope, not the complete native LINEAR animation. The150ms ingress is a fast eye/head raise; metrics are recorded in the verification.
155 discrete full/local steel-body samples do not prove collision freedom at every continuous time.
At source0.9 the inherited v7 wrist still includes lift-IK adjustment; this neck-only patch does not change that policy.
Normal-eye source/neck skin and same-time head/blade visual review, APK retargeting, SDK playback and device acceptance remain Root-owned review gates.

production_entry.only_attack_source_replaced: attack_overhead; existing attack_left and attack_right source assets stay unchanged
production_entry.authoring_manifest_requirement: Rebuild/update attack_source.authoring_manifest and its source_sha256 in the existing production attack78 contract to bind the complete v9 OVERHEAD source together with unchanged LEFT/RIGHT; do not assume this handoff JSON itself satisfies the old three-attack authoring-manifest schema.
production_entry.calibration_requirement: Retarget complete UNBAKED v9 raw first; retain reviewed R15 grip and apply each target right-finger calibration once and canonical root grounding once along that target production path.
production_entry.source_scope: Use the complete v9 raw animation as the production OVERHEAD source, not a runtime two-neck patch onto the current formal model; v9 contains the previously authored v7 full-body/right-arm/hand/blade tracks.
